interactive.label: Open BUR files
interactive.tooltip: Choose burst tables containing photon ranges to fit.

interactive.label: Add burst folder
interactive.tooltip: Find BUR tables recursively in an analysis folder.

interactive.label: MMFDB datasets
interactive.tooltip: Select a burst analysis dataset from MMFDB.

interactive.label: Clear burst files
interactive.tooltip: Remove the input tables and previous fitted result.

interactive.label: Stop fit
interactive.tooltip: Cancel the optimizer at its next progress checkpoint.

interactive.label: ▶ Fit Kinetics
interactive.tooltip: Fit the photon-by-photon kinetic model (Gopich–Szabo). Load .bur files and set the channels below first.

interactive.label: 💾 Export CSV
interactive.tooltip: Run a fit first; the results are then exported as CSV.

interactive.label: 📖 Guide
interactive.tooltip: Start a step-by-step guided tour of this tool.

interactive.label: ❓ Help
interactive.tooltip: Open the help window with reference documentation.

interactive.label: Use Simulation Mode
interactive.tooltip: Generate simulated burst trains instead of reading .bur files, to test the fitting.

interactive.label: Data Input & Channels
interactive.tooltip: Expand or collapse data input & channels controls.

interactive.label: Donor Channels
interactive.tooltip: Comma-separated routing channels assigned to the donor (e.g. 0, 8).

interactive.label: Acceptor Channels
interactive.tooltip: Comma-separated routing channels assigned to the acceptor (e.g. 1, 9).

interactive.label: Min Photons/Burst
interactive.tooltip: Bursts with fewer photons than this are excluded from the fit.

interactive.label: Kinetic Model Settings
interactive.tooltip: Expand or collapse kinetic model settings controls.

interactive.label: Number of States
interactive.tooltip: Number of FRET states in the kinetic model (2–4).

interactive.label: Initial Rate (s⁻¹)
interactive.tooltip: Starting guess for all transition rates in s⁻¹.

interactive.label: Max Iterations
interactive.tooltip: Maximum number of optimizer iterations before the fit gives up.

interactive.label: Fix Efficiencies
interactive.tooltip: Keep the state FRET efficiencies fixed while fitting the rates.

interactive.label: Scan Transition Time
interactive.tooltip: Scan a range of transition times and report the likelihood profile.

interactive.label: Decode State Trajectories
interactive.tooltip: Decode the most likely state sequence per photon and show the transition profile.

interactive.label: data_dir
interactive.tooltip: Resolve raw measurement filenames from the BUR table against this folder.

interactive.label: file_type
interactive.tooltip: Use auto to detect the container, or specify SPC-130, PTU, HT3 or HDF.

interactive.label: method
interactive.tooltip: Choose nelder-mead or l-bfgs-b.

interactive.label: Macro-time tick (ns)
interactive.tooltip: Zero reads the header resolution; an explicit tick rescales all fitted rates.

interactive.label: Simulated photon rate (kHz)
interactive.tooltip: Detected photons per millisecond within each simulated burst.

interactive.label: Maximum bursts
interactive.tooltip: Limit the input for a quick fit; zero uses all bursts.

interactive.label: Simulated photons / burst
interactive.tooltip: Number of photons in every simulated burst.

interactive.label: Transition scan points
interactive.tooltip: Number of finite-transition-time hypotheses in the likelihood scan.

interactive.label: Cross-check H2MM
interactive.tooltip: Compare the photon-by-photon fit with the discrete-time H2MM method.
